Name: parcel_audit_input_operation
Sql: CREATE INDEX parcel_audit_input_operation ON parcel_audit(json_extract(detail,'$.OperationId')) WHERE event='InputObserved' AND json_valid(detail)

Name: parcel_commands_pending
Sql: CREATE INDEX parcel_commands_pending ON parcel_commands(id) WHERE json_extract(receipt,'$.Status')='Pending'
